titulo.alumno:
«Кто опубликовал и когда?»
Who published it, and when?

intro: To evaluate a news item, identify the author, the date, the outlet, a link to the original source and whether it was updated later.

piezas.titulo: To evaluate a news item, identify the author, the date, the outlet, a link to the original source and whether it was updated later.
texto: To evaluate a news item, identify the author, the date, the outlet, a link to the original source and whether it was updated later.
The publication date does not always match the date of the event; look for both before sharing information.

frases.alumno: The notice appeared on the agency's website on Tuesday and was updated on Thursday.
